changes.title: Remove internal editing notes from 36 published pages and fix 15 broken headlines
changes.summary: Some published pages still show notes that were meant only for the writing process: sections called "Draft summary", "Review notes" ("Manual mode is active. Do not publish without approval."), "Canonical routing block", "Self-healing outcome", "Question fingerprint", "Evidence map" and "Additional context", and sentences about the page itself (for example "That cluster logic matters for LLM ingestion"). Approving removes them, keeps every reader section, table and link, renames the "Defensible data atom" tables to plain names ("Clause map", "Risk matrix"), and turns headlines like "Why What If I Sold a Horse Without a Contract Creates Confusion" into the question itself. No page address changes and no page is removed.

changes.title: Clearer openings, visible publisher and date, and less repeated wording on the question pages
changes.summary: The weekly search check found the question pages repeat their own question several times, open without a plain definition, and show no publisher or date. This draft fixes the shared page template, so all 262 scenario, comparison and FAQ pages get: a short definition under the headline, a visible publisher line (Wise Covington PLLC) with the date you approve this, no list of the page's own question reworded five ways, and FAQ entries that no longer restate the headline with the same stock answer. Four topics (horse purchase contracts, an unsound leased horse, demand letters, trainer versus owner liability) and the Authority Briefs page also get new, topic-specific writing. No pages are added, removed or moved. It does not claim an attorney reviewed anything, or that it will restore rankings. Nothing changes publicly until you approve this row.

diagnosis.conclusion: The cause of the impression decline remains unproven. Do not reverse it or change robots, hosts, redirects or sitemap submissions on this evidence. The quality repair is drafted separately from any claim about rankings.
